gws-script-push 1.0.0

- Initial release.
- Adds a command to upload local files to a Google Apps Script project.
- Supports .gs, .js, .html, and appsscript.json files; skips hidden files and node_modules.
- Provides flags for script project ID and custom directory selection.
- Warns users that all files in the Apps Script project will be replaced.
